text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан wins the Arima Kinen in a

magnificent showing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Clearly frustrated, Хиши Амадзон vows to

challenge her again. Нарита Брайан looks
forward to
their rematches, knowing
Amazon will never give
up,
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We've crossed paths with quite a few
strong
racers over the past year, and
racing against them
has given Narita
Brian great satisfaction.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The new year brings the start of her
senior year,
and our next goal—the
Hanshin Daishoten!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
